<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A long read: sections with headings, text and an optional pull quote, in one reading column or beside a table
  of contents that links to each section. Axes: layout (column, toc), quotes (show, hide), tone. Highlighting
  the section being read is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Section } from "./article-body.types";

  export type ArticleBodyProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    sections: Section[];
    empty?: string;
    tocTitle: string;
    layout?: "column" | "toc";
    quotes?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Link from "../compose/Link.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    sections,
    empty = "",
    tocTitle,
    layout = "column",
    quotes = "show",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ArticleBodyProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((sections?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="file-text" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Grid
      cols="1"
      class={cn(
        "items-start gap-8",
        (((layout as string) === "toc") ? "md:grid-cols-[14rem_minmax(0,1fr)]" : "")
      )}
    >
      {#if ((layout as string) === "toc")}
        <NavBlock
          label={(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl("{0}, {1}", tocTitle, landmarkLabel)) : tocTitle)}
          class="md:sticky md:top-4"
          testid="toc"
        >
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {tocTitle}
            </Text>
            <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
              {#each sections as s (s.id)}
                <ListItem data-slot="sections-row">
                  <Link
                    href={urlOf(tpl("#{0}-{1}", id, s.id))}
                    variant="default"
                    class="text-sm text-muted-foreground"
                    data-slot="toc-link"
                  >
                    {s.title}
                  </Link>
                </ListItem>
              {/each}
            </List>
          </Stack>
        </NavBlock>
      {/if}
      <Stack gap="8" align="stretch" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-2xl min-w-0" data-slot="article">
        {#each sections as s (s.id)}
          <Box class="flex flex-col gap-4" id={tpl("{0}-{1}", id, s.id)} data-slot="item">
            <Title as={3} size="2xl" weight="bold">
              {s.title}
            </Title>
            <Text size="base">
              {s.text}
            </Text>
            {#if ((quotes as string) === "show")}
              {#if s.quote}
                <Text tag="blockquote" class="m-0 border-l border-border pl-4 text-lg" data-slot="quote">
                  {s.quote}
                </Text>
              {/if}
            {/if}
          </Box>
        {/each}
      </Stack>
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
